_meta.purpose: Tiny hand-written fixture standing in for a real Tally master export (data/tally-masters.json). Lets the resolution-stress generator be developed and tested without the actual export. Shape matches the master-export tool: { company, ledgers[], stock[] }.
_meta.warning: Synthetic. Names are realistic Indian B2B masters but fictitious; never load into a real Tally company.

fields.ledgers: Party / supplier ledgers. {name, parent_group, closing_balance}. Some share a base name across branch suffixes to exercise branch-collapse stress.
fields.stock: Stock items. {name, parent_group, aliases[], hsn_code, base_unit}. The product often lives in alias/parent, not the card name.
